verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for a government web portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows that the portal serves a JavaScript shell behind an account and that the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing documents telemetry, analytics, cookie-consent or tracking opt-out controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
